notices.batchScope: Feed results cover the whole selected batch. FCR is not averaged across batches.
notices.fcrHelp: FCR means feed conversion ratio: kilograms of feed used for one kilogram of eggs or bird growth. Missing production weights or feed records can make it unavailable.
notices.estimated: Some results are estimates. Review the source records before relying on profit or feed comparisons.
notices.stockPeriod: Receipts, usage and expenses cover the selected dates for the whole warehouse. Stock remaining is the current balance, not the period-end balance. chartHints.feedProduction: Each dot is a laying flock: feed per bird-day horizontally, egg-production rate vertically. Association does not establish cause or an ideal ration.
chartHints.eggs: Recorded output by operating day. Gaps mean missing records, not zero production.
chartHints.hdep: Bird-day-weighted production against available age targets. Missing targets are not assumed.
chartHints.marketableRate: Saleable eggs as a share of recorded production over time.
chartHints.eggQuality: Recorded egg quality. Unknown quantities prevent a complete composition.
chartHints.growth: Latest measured weights and age targets. Check measurement dates below.
chartHints.flockProduction: Each flock’s recorded production beside its available target.
chartHints.session_actual: Actual feed in columns; recorded plans as a dashed line. No fixed feeding schedule is assumed.
chartHints.feedPerBirdGrams: Feed per bird-day. Lower intake alone does not mean better performance.
chartHints.feedTypes: Recorded quantities by feed type, using the same unit.
chartHints.sessionStatus: Completed, missed and unfinished sessions. Missed is not the same as unrecorded.
chartHints.deaths: Deaths and culls shown separately. Sales and supporting events are not counted again.
chartHints.lossComposition: Deaths and intentional culls within recorded losses, not a diagnosis.
chartHints.recordedDeathCauses: Recorded supporting causes, not additional deaths.
chartHints.healthActivity: Recorded treatments, completed vaccinations and health issues. Counts do not establish prevalence.
chartHints.revenue: Sales, collections against those sales and balances. This is not period cash flow.
chartHints.expenseCategories: Recorded costs by category. Missing costs limit margin interpretation.
chartHints.collections: Collections and outstanding balances against selected sales, not payment-date receipts.

FarmPerformance.subtitle: Understand your farm’s results, check the evidence, and see what needs attention.

FarmPerformance.savedNote: Saved reports are frozen evidence, not live results. New reports cover all topics; older reports retain their original production-only format.

notices.production: Egg results apply to laying flocks. Growth targets use the bird’s age at measurement; missing targets and stale weights limit comparisons.
notices.feeding: Plans come from recorded sessions, not an assumed number of daily feedings. Lower feed alone does not mean better performance.
notices.health: Deaths and culls are separate. Recorded causes and treatments are evidence, not an automatic diagnosis.
notices.stock: Balances belong to whole warehouses, not a house or flock. Opening and period-end balances follow selected dates; current balances are as of refresh. Values use current prices and are estimates.
notices.salesCosts: Collections are amounts paid against the selected sales, not cash received during these dates. Profit estimates are not reconciled accounting results.
notices.overview: Changes describe the previous equal-length period. Direction alone is not a judgment of good or bad performance.

labels.growthFcr: Feed per kg of bird growth
labels.currentLowStockItems: Items low or out of stock now

explanations.WEIGHTED_RATE: Calculated from compatible totals, not an average of daily percentages.
explanations.NO_APPLICABLE_RECORDS: No applicable records for this period.
explanations.FEED_NOT_A_HEALTH_DIAGNOSIS: Feed changes alone do not establish a health problem.
explanations.LAYER_FCR_ONLY: Egg feed conversion applies only to laying flocks with feed and egg-weight evidence.
explanations.RECORDED_HEALTH_EVENTS_ONLY: Zero recorded events does not confirm that no health problems occurred.
explanations.DAILY_LOSSES_NOT_SUPPORTING_EVENTS: Daily records supply loss totals; supporting events are not counted twice.
explanations.REPORT_LOAD_FAILED: One source failed to load. No zero result has been substituted.
explanations.CURRENT_PRICE_ESTIMATE: Stock value uses current item prices, not historical accounting valuation.
explanations.COLLECTIONS_AGAINST_SELECTED_SALES: Collections belong to the selected sales, regardless of payment date.
explanations.ESTIMATED_MARGIN: Margin is an estimate and may exclude costs not represented in its basis.
explanations.RECONCILED_MARGIN: Margin uses the available reconciled cost basis.
explanations.RECORDED_SESSION_PLAN_ONLY: Plans cover recorded feeding sessions only; no missing plan is invented.
explanations.INCOMPLETE_FEED_DAYS: Check closed-day coverage before treating feeding totals as complete.
explanations.GROWTH_FCR_ONLY: Growth conversion requires compatible weights, feed and population evidence.
explanations.AMBIGUOUS_MOVEMENT_DAY_EXCLUDED: Evidence without a clear location on a transfer date was excluded.

concernLabels.productionDown: Egg production fell against the previous period
concernLabels.mortalityUp: Death rate increased against the previous period
concernLabels.quality: Broken or dirty eggs are reducing saleable output

FarmPerformance.outsidePeriod: Some weight measurements are outside the selected period. See each measurement date in supporting figures; do not treat an older sample as current-period growth.
